media.title: Così, cosa (A Night at the Opera, 1935) — sheet music cover
media.description: Sheet-music cover for “Così, cosa,” the song from the MGM film A Night at the Opera (1935), with words by Ned Washington and music by Bronisław Kaper and Walter Jurmann, published by Robbins Music Corporation. The local image is reproduced from the University of Southern California Digital Library record identified by DocRID 2A3BF1X8Z8LXZ. Bibliographic details are independently supported by the U.S. Copyright Office Catalog of Copyright Entries.
media.altText: Vintage sheet-music cover for “Così, cosa,” associated with the Marx Brothers film A Night at the Opera.
